name: CI Agent · A - Daily Collection & Triage

parameters.content:
## Workflow A — Daily Collection & Triage
Runs every morning: reads the competitor list from Google Sheets, pulls Google News + blog RSS, removes items already seen, classifies each item with Gemini (structured JSON), alerts Telegram for impact ≥ 7 and logs everything to the `Intel_Log` sheet.

**Setup:** fill `sheet_id` and `telegram_chat_id` in **Config**, then select your Google Sheets, Gemini and Telegram credentials.

messageValues.message:
You are a senior competitive-intelligence analyst covering the product-management / work-management software market (Notion, Atlassian Jira & Confluence, Asana, monday.com, Linear and similar tools).
You receive ONE news or blog item about a competitor. Classify it and score its strategic importance for a competing product team.

Categories (choose exactly one):
- pricing: price changes, new plans or tiers, discounts, packaging, free-tier changes
- product_launch: new products, features, AI capabilities, integrations or major releases
- hiring: executive hires or departures, layoffs, team expansion, new offices
- partnership: partnerships, acquisitions, investments, alliances with other companies
- campaign: marketing campaigns, events, rebrands, positioning or go-to-market pushes
- other: anything else (earnings, legal, opinion pieces, listicles, tutorials)

impact_score (integer 1-10):
- 9-10: could change the market or our roadmap now (major pricing change, flagship AI launch, big acquisition)
- 7-8: significant move a product leader should hear about today
- 4-6: notable, worth logging for the weekly brief
- 1-3: noise (generic listicles, minor tips, passing mentions)
If the item is not really about the named competitor, set is_relevant=false, category=other and impact_score=1.
Be calibrated: most items should score below 7. Base your answer only on the text given.

parameters.jsonOutput:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  date: $now.toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd'),
  competitor: $('Limit Items').item.json.competitor,
  source_type: $('Limit Items').item.json.source_type,
  title: $('Limit Items').item.json.title,
  link: $('Limit Items').item.json.link,
  published: $('Limit Items').item.json.published,
  category: $json.output.category,
  impact_score: Number($json.output.impact_score),
  is_relevant: $json.output.is_relevant,
  summary: $json.output.summary,
  reasoning: $json.output.reasoning,
  model_used: 'gemini-2.5-flash'
}) }}
